title: Tokenized Reward Systems for Federated Learning: The Privacy vs. Fairness Tradeoff
abstract: arXiv:2611.16065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) systems increasingly rely on blockchain based reward mechanisms to incentivize participation while preserving data privacy. We design and empirically evaluate two complementary Solidity smart contracts for FL reward distribution: the first one that allocates rewards proportionally to a publicly disclosed quality score, and a privacy preserving variant that hides individual quality scores behind a zero-knowledge (ZK) proof of a threshold condition. Both contracts mint a non transferable, use-and-burn token maintaining a trustless incentive structure. We evaluate the two designs through MNIST training with adversarial behavior, including Sybil attacks, zero gradient and random noise, across three independent random seeds.   Our results reveal a fundamental tradeoff between cryptographic privacy and incentive fairness. The privacy preserving architecture strictly degrades system robustness, doubling the adversary's

translated_title: 联邦学习的代币化奖励系统：隐私与公平的权衡
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）系统日益依赖基于区块链的奖励机制来激励参与并保护数据隐私。我们设计并实证评估了两个互补的用于联邦学习奖励分配的Solidity智能合约：第一个合约根据公开披露的质量分数按比例分配奖励；另一个是隐私保护变体，通过零知识（ZK）证明阈值条件来隐藏个体的质量分数。两个合约均铸造不可转让、使用即销毁的代币，以维持无需信任的激励结构。我们通过包含女巫攻击、零梯度和随机噪声等对抗行为的MNIST训练，在三个独立的随机种子下对两种设计进行了评估。我们的结果揭示了密码学隐私与激励公平之间的根本性权衡：隐私保护架构严格降低了系统的鲁棒性，使对手的（攻击收益）翻倍……
tldr: 本文设计了两种基于区块链智能合约的联邦学习奖励分配机制（公开质量分数与零知识证明隐私保护两种方案），实证揭示了密码学隐私与激励公平之间存在根本性权衡——采用零知识证明隐藏质量分数的隐私架构会显著削弱系统对女巫攻击等对抗行为的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper designs two blockchain smart contract-based reward mechanisms for federated learning—public quality scores versus zero-knowledge proof-based privacy preservation—and empirically reveals a fundamental tradeoff between cryptographic privacy and incentive fairness, showing that the privacy-preserving architecture strictly degrades system robustness against adversarial behaviors.
